messages:
jules: Quick sync — need to prioritize small, high-impact SDK + docs work for embeddings + rerank so customers can ship search + semantic-ranking POCs this quarter.

maya: +1. customers keep asking for a clear TS + Python example that wires embeddings -> reranker.

li: Agree. Will need two things from platform: a stable embeddings output shape and a canonical rerank endpoint param set. What fields should we promise in types?

sam: Platform note: rerank backend currently accepts `candidates` array with `text` or `embedding`. We'll add `candidate_limit` and `score_mode` in next deploy but it's not GA yet. Latency is fine for small candidate sets (<=50).

jules: So decision: ship docs + SDK examples assuming `embedding: number[]` and `RerankCandidate { id: string; text?: string; embedding?: number[] }`. In TS: `type Embedding = number[]; interface RerankCandidate { id: string; text?: string; embedding?: Embedding; }`

li: I'll add those exact defs to the TS client types. For Python, do we want typed stubs? dataclass `RerankCandidate`?

maya: Yes — minimal typed dataclass in examples is fine. Keep runtime accept any Mapping for backward compat. Example should show both text-only and embedding-based candidates.

sam: One blocker: API param name — backend currently uses `candidates` vs older `items`. We should standardize on `candidates`. I'll land a small compatibility shim in the routing layer this week.

eng-bot: ci/cd: rerank-shim branch passed tests and is queued for canary deploy tomorrow at 03:00 UTC.

jules: Acceptance criteria (short):
- TS + Python example notebooks (or single-file snippets) demonstrating embeddings -> rerank end-to-end (include example data and expected output).
- TS types and Python dataclass included in SDKs and docs.
- One short pluggable example showing function-calling style integration (i.e., rerank -> pick top N -> call tool).
- Changelog entry: `docs(sdk): add embeddings + rerank examples and types`
- Docs PR and SDK PRs merged, lightweight e2e smoke test green.

maya: Timeline: can we aim for a soft-docs ship by end of next sprint? I can draft examples this week if li and sam confirm shape.

li: I can cut the TS types + examples PR by Tue. Will include both callback and promise examples.

sam: I will finish the shim and add `score_mode` enum (`dot`, `cosine`) to API; note: cosine needs normalized embeddings or we'll normalize server-side (we'll do server-side normalization for now).

jules: Ok. Risk log:
- Breaking changes: if we switch param names post-doc, customers break. Avoid churn.
- Perf: large candidate sets will be slow — docs should call out recommended limits (<=100).
- Compatibility: provide example for text-only candidates using client-side embedding call.

maya: Draft checklist I'll put in PR body:
- [ ] example .ts and .py files
- [ ] types exported in SDKs
- [ ] README snippet + quickstart copy
- [ ] changelog entry
- [ ] smoke test (embeddings -> rerank end-to-end)

li: small code snippet for TS example I'll put in PR (WIP):
```ts
const embeddings = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwkv-embed-1', input: ['apple', 'banana'] });
const candidates = items.map((t, i) => ({ id: `${i}`, text: t, embedding: embeddings.data[i].embedding }));
const rerank = await client.rerank.create({ model: 'rw-rerank-v1', query: 'fruit list', candidates });
console.log(rerank.data[0].scores[0]);
```

maya: And Python snippet for docs:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
emb = client.embeddings.create(model='rwkv-embed-1', input=['apple','banana'])
candidates = [RerankCandidate(id=str(i), text=t, embedding=emb.data[i].embedding) for i,t in enumerate(items)]
rr = client.rerank.create(model='rw-rerank-v1', query='fruit list', candidates=candidates)
print(rr.data[0].scores[0])
```

jules: This looks good. Final call: Li + Sam to land SDK + shim this week; Maya to draft docs and examples; I'll review and merge next Monday. If any blocking API changes pop up, escalate to #eng-api. :thumbsup:

eng-bot: reminder: canary deploy scheduled 03:00 UTC tomorrow — monitor `#eng-oncall` for regressions.

maya: I'll open the docs PR now and link it here when ready.

li: PR for TS types opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/421 (WIP).

jules: thanks team — small, focused deliverable. We'll measure adoption and follow up with additional patterns for batch rerank next quarter. :rocket:
